name: skills
description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
one_liner: A free collection of pre-written instructions that make an AI coding assistant behave like an experienced engineer instead of a sloppy intern.
buyer: A coding educator or newsletter creator building an audience of developers who want to use AI assistants more effectively — the repo's own author is already doing this.
business_use_cases: A dev-education creator uses the free repo as a funnel into a paid newsletter or cohort course on 'real engineering with AI' (exactly the model the author already runs).
An engineering-training company licenses or adapts a curated skill pack as part of a corporate 'AI coding onboarding' workshop.
A plugin marketplace sells premium, industry-specific skill packs (fintech compliance skills, healthcare data-handling skills) built on the same pattern.

money_ideas.idea: Free skill pack as a lead magnet into a paid newsletter or course on engineering with AI.
Premium, specialized skill packs sold a la carte to teams in regulated industries.

steal_this: Clone the funnel, not just the skills: publish 5 free, genuinely excellent skills for a narrow niche (e.g. 'Shopify app developers') and use it to build a paid newsletter list this weekend.
